regime_context: China A-shares shows an extreme one-narrative rotation: Coal is the sole eligible leader with a score of 0.992 and narrow breadth (2 eligible of 22 themes), but the absolute-trend gate did NOT hold on this market's history and cross-sectional momentum has near-zero rank-IC — so the entire read is display-only, not alpha. With gate_helps=false and a track record showing directional accuracy of only 0.337 on 98 calls, any leans must be very low conviction and framed as conditionals.
emerging_watch: Gold Miners (rank 2, score 0.935) is the closest challenger to Coal but is NOT eligible and has breadth 0.0 — watching whether it becomes eligible AND breadth expands above 0.3, which would signal a confirmed leadership handoff from Coal to Gold Miners; until that breadth+eligibility turn happens together, the watch stays open.

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the dominant eligible theme, ranked #1 with the only passing trend-gate eligibility and a durability_bar above 0.5. The one-narrative structure means leadership is concentrating here rather than rotating. This is a case for retaining exposure to the incumbent leader while it holds trend health, not a momentum chase — and only conditional on the trend gate continuing to validate on a forward basis.
theses.dissent: The market tape is mean-reverting (hurst_tag on Coal itself is mean-revert) and the absolute-trend gate did_NOT_hold_here historically, meaning Coal's breakout could whip back hard and the gate would fail to protect the position exactly when needed.

falsifier.text: Coal ETF 515220.SS closes below its 20-day moving average for three consecutive sessions before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are eligible, rank #3, with the strongest durability (0.83) and full breadth (1.0) — but crowding_z of 1.83 flags them as crowded. Crowding is a down-size caution, never a fade, so this is a lean to hold smaller relative exposure to Banks rather than a directional short. The crowding flag simply argues against adding here despite the strong trend.
theses.dissent: Banks have the cleanest trending structure in the entire ranks (durability 0.83, full breadth) and high crowding in a reflexive tape can persist far longer than valuation or positioning logic suggests — underweighting the one genuinely durable trend is a real opportunity cost.

falsifier.text: Banks ETF 512800.SS makes a new 60-day high with a crowding_z falling back below 1.0 (crowding unwinds) before the check-by date.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
